description: Pinned source versions for UniPad experiments (PRD 8.1 inputs). Every run must be reproducible from this file plus the recorded hashes.

device_repo.commit_note: Pinned 2026-10-29. A fork of xVanTuring/UniXNU-qemu at the previous pin 5c0770d3074c9827be943edbd6ab0a8fabb11ac1 (itself a comment correction) plus exactly one commit, which raises [payload] kernel_args' offline-legacy-surface-wait-ms from its 120000 default to 600000. MEASURED over ten boots of one matched build on the Windows host: four reached native_legacy_stage=10 and six stopped at stage 8, the give-up path, and in all six native_legacy_surface_status was 0 (the IOSurface kext loaded) with surface_found=0 -- so waitForMatchingService("IOCoreSurfaceRoot") timed out rather than the kext being absent. With 600000 the same build reached stage 10 on both of the next two boots, with surface_found=1, unit_scale_calls=1, chosen_scale=1, native_gop_ready=1, and native_gpu_addon_stage=1 / status=2 (the addon mount attempted and refused ENOENT, as previously recorded). The wait is on its own thread -- what this fork's first commit bought -- so a longer value costs only time on a boot that would fail anyway, while a boot that loses the display silently is the expensive kind; the 120 s default was calibrated for a boot whose mountroot completed at t=49.6 s and whose surface landed at t=63.6 s, and the stalled boots are roughly twice as slow throughout. NOTE the three commits before this one on this fork are comment corrections recording a measurement error: a four-boot 'control' was taken to refute the claim that sheng-fb-gpu=1 constructs the presenter, but unipad's stage_esp() regenerates unixnu.toml from board.toml when BootInputs.payload_toml is None, so the payload image's own args are never read and all four boots carried sheng-fb-gpu=1 from here; the original conclusion stands. Platform seed moves cce5d68284272b42 -> the value derived from this commit; verify_adt's leading-zero comparison defect is already fixed. Upstream is read-only for this account; the fork is public and carries no private material. Re-pin to upstream as soon as the change is accepted there.

feeds.ref_note: the device repository's feeds.toml overrides UniXNU's ref 'main' with this tag; the commit is identical, but re-fetching by the old ref is how a pin silently stops being a pin

feeds_note: The union of TWO feeds.toml files, not one: UniXNU/feeds.toml and the device repository's UniXNU-qemu/feeds.toml (which 'adds to' UniXNU's and may override a ref). dyld comes from the device repository alone and IOStorageFamily's ref is the device's override. A lock derived from UniXNU's feeds.toml by itself is missing dyld -- that is exactly the gap this note exists to prevent, found by cross-checking `unixnu status` against this array on 2026-10-24 (8 of 9 agreed; dyld was absent here). Re-derive with `unixnu status -D <device>` and compare every `refer` line.
frozen_note: Not frozen, and the reason is the BUILD, not the compiler. tools.clang IS proven to cross-compile AArch64/iOS on this host (three independent lines of evidence, see tools.clang.note); what is missing is a clean XNU build run against these pins, which needs six build blockers cleared (docs/kernel-build-windows.md) and two required XNU patches applied to the build tree (kits/NativePrelink/patches/xnu-10063.141.1-sparse-index.patch and -security-init.patch, both currently UNAPPLIED). The firmware layer IS verified on the host (see tools.firmware_boot). Set frozen=true only after a clean XNU build succeeds against these pins. CLOSED 2026-10-23: gpu.vram_gb is now MEASURED at 4.0 GB (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 Laptop GPU, from Win32_VideoController.AdapterRAM; host-inventory.json gpu.vram_evidence), and VT-x is now MEASURED as present but DISABLED IN FIRMWARE (Win32_Processor.VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled) -- which makes -accel tcg the only option on this host rather than a preference, and is recorded in host-inventory.json cpu.vt_x_note. STILL OUTSTANDING and not to be counted as done: PRD 6 row M0 names an AI/Step API smoke test as pass evidence, and no such smoke test exists on this host yet.

pinned_checkouts_note: Three repositories are pinned here, and only two of them are in `feeds`. `unixnu` and `device_repo` are the two the driver cannot clone for itself (cli.py has no subcommand that clones either; scripts/unixnu/config.py raises 'no device repository' without -D), so the workflow's acquisition step clones them into vendor/. `uefi_sheng` is NOT a feed on purpose: the driver's feeds.fetch() resolves sources named by a feeds.toml and writes them into out/<board>/feeds, and uefi-sheng is named by no feeds.toml -- it is the Mu-Silicium checkout the driver's --uefi option points at (cli.py:24). Adding it to `feeds` would make the workflow's cross-check demand it in the driver's own unixnu.lock, where it will never appear, and would fail every run. So it is pinned here, acquired by the same step, and verified by the one file the build actually reads (uefi_sheng.font_header.sha256) rather than by a feed pin. Measured 2026-10-25: with it absent, build-payload failed on run 40094234507 and 40096928333 with 'Font.h is missing'.

submodules.commit_note: MOVED BACK one commit from UniXNU's own gitlink, deliberately and on evidence. Measured on run 40187668943 (stage M4): build-os-root.py reached step 9 for the first time -- storage-abi, both signed policies, the verified-root probe, NativeVirtioBlock/NativeRamBlock verified bindings, the grown 1 GiB OwnerData volume (675761EF-5622-4F5B-89DF-4CAD5BA456F6) and the packed ramdisk all passed -- and then died in build-native-legacy-display.py -> build-arm-driver.py NativeLegacyDisplay with `NativeLegacyDisplay.cpp:206:59: error: only virtual member functions can be marked 'override'` and `:207:13: error: no member named 'getRefreshAttributes' in 'IOMobileFramebufferLegacy'`. The pinned device repository (xVanTuring/UniXNU-qemu 97b75b1f, its only branch, at its tip) generates OriginalLegacyFramebufferABI.h from a fixed slot table that has no entry for slot 301, and its own invariant then refuses the override: `require(i in (0,1,7,14,84,86,87,141,155,184,188,288,290,296) or i in pure, 'Only qualified own methods and guarded leaves override')`. So the device repository is incompatible with c031d882 and with everything after it, and there is no newer device commit to move to. c031d882 is `feat(display): report the panel refresh rate`; eb9c949 is its parent `fix(gop): re-kick the swap queue after each retirement`, whose override set is exactly the one the device repository's generator declares. What is given up is the sheng-vsync refresh-rate report, which is gated on a boot argument this board does not pass and affects no root-mount or launchd path (PRD/Goal 6: the display is not a gate for them). gitlink_commit records what UniXNU b881ac7d actually pins so the divergence is auditable rather than silent; build-macos.yml forces the assembled tree's checkout to `commit` before it runs the chain.

system_identity.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-10-23 (ADR-0001 open item 3). Evidence: (a) the pinned device_repo board.toml line 18 declares build = "21H461"; (b) the same board.toml line 15 pins the IPSW URL whose filename carries 21H461; (c) the downloaded IPSW's BuildManifest.plist reports ProductBuildVersion 21H461. The PRD appendix A spelling 21H161 is therefore the transcription error and is superseded.

clang.note: Present on this host as a HOST compiler (x86_64-w64-windows-gnu) AND PROVEN to cross-compile AArch64/iOS. Three independent lines of evidence, all re-run on this host: (1) clang -target arm64-apple-ios17.0 -c emits real Mach-O arm64 objects whose disassembly shows genuine AArch64 instructions, and ld64.lld links a real Mach-O arm64 executable (docs/implementation-plan.md fact 4); (2) docs/kernel-build-windows.md records 61 of 123 osfmk/kern translation units compiled to genuine Mach-O 64-bit arm64 objects, including the 138 KB / 174-symbol osfmk/kern/bsd_kern.c; (3) an 80-line shim plus three -D rewrites for the Apple-clang-only builtins takes that to 79 of 123 with zero regressions. CORRECTION to an earlier note here, which said 'NOT yet proven to cross-compile AArch64/iOS: no iOS sysroot' -- that conflated two different facts. There is indeed no iOS sysroot, and that is still true; but cross-compiling to a Mach-O arm64 object does not require one when the headers are supplied, which is exactly what the freestanding header shim does. The claim of 'not proven' was wrong. What is NOT done is a clean XNU BUILD against these pins -- six build blockers remain (iig, csh/doconf, the five SETUP host tools, ditto/python3 wiring, the Darwin freestanding header set, the Apple-clang builtins; docs/kernel-build-windows.md has the detail), and two required XNU patches are still unapplied in the build tree. availability.pl is present and runs under the host Python (907 lines / 292 macros emitted), so it is not a blocker. mig IS built and working (bootstrap_cmds-138, 73/73 kernel MIG outputs); unifdef and mtools are present in the MSYS2 tree.

uefi_sheng.checkout_note: A full checkout IS a Mu-Silicium checkout (Resources/Scripts/mkbootimg.py and BootShim/BootShim.S are present at this commit), which is what --uefi of the driver documents (cli.py:24) and what step_assemble_image validates (build-macos.sh:2654). Do not replace it with a sparse checkout of the font directory alone.
uefi_sheng.commit_note: Pinned 2026-10-25 at the tip of the default branch `sheng` (tarball UniXNU-uefi-sheng-v4.0-52-g20ac23d). The third pinned checkout: NOT a feed and NOT part of either repository above. board.toml [payload] panic_screen = true (UniXNU-qemu/board.toml:94) makes `unixnu build payload` run the device repository's patch-xnu-entry-probe.py --panic-screen, which compiles scripts/xnu-panic-screen.c; that file's ONLY include is "Font.h" (xnu-panic-screen.c:294) and patch-xnu-entry-probe.py:183 takes it from (UNIXNU_UEFI or <tree>/uefi-sheng)/Silicon/Silicium/SiliciumPkg/Library/FrameBufferSerialPortLib. The assembled build tree never contains uefi-sheng/ (tree.py:assemble creates only drivers/ kits/ patches/ refer/ build/ .cache/ package/ scripts/), so without this pin the payload stage died in clang with "fatal error: 'Font.h' file not found" -- measured on run 40094234507.

unixnu.commit_note: Pinned 2026-10-28. A fork of UniXNU/UniXNU at the previous pin b881ac7dc1695ce676c856873051a487c6a9f963 (verified through api.github.com as this commit's parent) plus exactly one commit, which moves native_legacy_display_late_probe() from the end of bsd_autoconf() to just after IOSecureBSDRoot(rootdevice). The five-second waitForMatchingService for "IOCoreSurfaceRoot" used to block the mountroot that publishes the service. Upstream is read-only for this account, so the fix cannot be delivered there; the fork is public and carries no private material. Re-pin to upstream as soon as the change is accepted there.
